name: Ottie Swale
bio: A collier from Thornwold's near side, the fourth of the four who went up after the Lamp for a lantern of their own and went on north by the old Keepers' road. Never once waited to be told a thing. Keeps a charcoal fire in the Northing's fire-basket for the three who went down to the far shore. Left his boots on his seat and his cap on a waymark. Half-Hushed.
